decisions.text: behaviour: the supervisor reads a reset time in the machine's local time and ignores any zone name in the message, so a limit that names another zone may wait too long or too short — reverse: parse the zone in resetWaitMs

behaviour: the sweep does not run prune-merged-worktrees.sh. sweepFolders() in run-supervisor.mjs does its own checks on the orch-merge and orch-<run>-<NNN> folders, and the sweep scripts are unchanged — reverse: call the script from the supervisor's main()

behaviour: a run counts as live when its supervisor pid is alive or its status.json says running and was touched within 15 minutes; orphan-sweep.mjs is skipped while any run is live — reverse: change liveRuns()
behaviour: a stopped run (a stop other than a rate limit) is not relaunched, and a child that dies before writing status.json counts as a death — reverse: edit supervise()
seen: core/.claude/commands/orchestrate.md — writes are refused as a sensitive file in this environment, which blocks S7
behaviour: a launch of run-plans.mjs that never reaches init (a refusal, or a crash before it) ends the supervisor and is not relaunched — reverse: in classify(), treat kind 'refused' like 'died'

behaviour: the sweep calls orphan-sweep.mjs and free-merged-slots.mjs --no-fetch but not prune-merged-worktrees.sh, because that script works on .claude/worktrees (session worktrees, not run leftovers) and its --confirm uses --force/rm -rf — reverse: add ['prune-merged-worktrees.sh'] (via bash) to the list in sweepLeftovers()

behaviour: a run folder that git does not list as a worktree is kept with the line 'remove it by hand', never deleted with a recursive delete — reverse: in sweepLeftovers(), remove it instead of keep(...)

behaviour: when the rate-limit message names a reset time, the wait is that time plus one minute; when the next wait would push the total past 6 hours, the supervisor stops the run ('supervisor gave up: the rate-limit waits would pass 6 hours …') rather than relaunching early — reverse: clamp waitMs to what is left of the 6 hours instead of giving up

removes: /orchestrate's own 'relaunch once after a harness kill' step and the hand relaunch after a rate limit (the supervisor now does both; this takes effect only once the blocked orchestrate.md edit lands) — reverse: restore steps 3 and 4 of core/.claude/commands/orchestrate.md from b94afb4
